document.about: True T-49-HC refrigerator spec sheet. Its second page sets its standard features as bold section heads over bulleted items in a text column, beside and above a drawing of the cabinet.

notes: #279: list items are no drawing's labels, so the figure's reach went over them to the section head above, and the head yielded to the figure.

checks.issue: #279: `CABINET CONSTRUCTION`, a section head with its items between it and the drawing, was a Figure.
